entities.summary: Pavel Bulatnikov (b. 1972-06-27, Orenburg) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Orenburg and Belarus. Known in the fields of belarus, composers & musicians, europe.
